x=3cos⁡θ,y=2sin⁡θ.

What is the domain of the parameter θ?

a
θ∈[−π,π]
b
θ∈[0,π]
c
θ∈[0,π2]
d
θ∈[−π2,π2]
e
θ∈[0,2π)
